description:
Pro Football Board puts the week's pro football slate on one screen, built natively for iPhone and iPad.

BEFORE KICKOFF
- Every game of the week with kickoff time in US Central
- Venue, roof and kickoff-hour stadium weather: temperature, wind, rain chance
- TV network and streaming service
- Season matchup metrics from nflverse: EPA per play, success rate and more, side by side

DURING THE GAMES
- Live score, clock, down and distance, and the last play
- A field graphic that shows who has the ball and how far to the goal line
- Drive tracker: every drive with start, result, plays and yards
- Win probability chart built with Swift Charts
- A live desk that ranks the games in progress by how tight and late they are

GAME SHEET
- Tap any live or final game for the scoring summary, team stats, passing, rushing and receiving leaders and every drive

FOLLOW YOUR TEAMS
- Follow teams to get a Following tab with just their games
- Team chips in team colors, no logos needed

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with scores and kickoff times, configurable by team
- Shortcuts and Siri phrases to open the board or show the live games

DATA
Scores and play data come from ESPN's public feed, season metrics from nflverse (CC BY 4.0), weather from Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking.

Pro Football Board is a stats display for fans of NFL games. It is independent and unofficial, and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by the National Football League or any team.
promotionalText: Live drives, win probability, kickoff weather and season metrics for every game of the week. Widgets for the teams you follow. No account, no ads.
